summary.name: iA Writer
summary.one_liner: iA Writer is a minimalist Markdown text editor for writing in plain text, with a focus mode and optional styled preview, available for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android, and Windows.
use_cases: drafting articles and essays in plain text
writing in Markdown on Mac and iOS devices
reviewing prose for clichés and filler words
exporting text to PDF, Word, or HTML
summary.what_it_does:
iA Writer is a plain-text writing app built around Markdown, with few buttons or menus. Focus Mode highlights the sentence or paragraph being written and fades the rest of the text. Style Check flags clichés, fillers, and clutter, and the page states it runs on the device. Writers can switch to a Preview to see Markdown rendered in styled form, and can copy text as plain Markdown or HTML, or export to PDF or Word. The page also says syntax highlighting colors parts of speech such as adjectives, nouns, and verbs, and that the app offers find and replace.</what_it_does>
